description_en: Queries the log delivery configuration change task for the current account by task ID and returns the operation type, execution status, and failure information. When UpdateDeliveryDestination returns a TaskId, you can use the value to poll this operation until the Status is 2 or 3
description_zh: 根据任务 ID 查询当前账号的日志投递配置变更任务，返回操作类型、执行状态以及失败信息。当 UpdateDeliveryDestination 返回 TaskId 时，可使用该值轮询本接口，直至 Status 为 2 或 3
name: DescribeLogDeliveryTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the log delivery task. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. When UpdateDeliveryDestination returns a TaskId, use the returned value
parameters.help_zh: 日志投递任务 ID，取值不小于 1。当 UpdateDeliveryDestination 返回 TaskId 时，使用该返回值
parameters.name: task_id

Data.description_en: The details of the log delivery task

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code of the task. This parameter is returned only when Status is 3. If ErrorSource is SLS, a Simple Log Service error code is returned. If ErrorSource is SYSTEM, InternalError is returned
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务错误码，仅当 Status 为 3 时返回。ErrorSource 为 SLS 时返回日志服务错误码；为 SYSTEM 时返回 InternalError

ErrorSource.description_en: The error source of the task. This parameter is returned only when Status is 3. Valid values: SLS: a Simple Log Service error. SYSTEM: a system processing error
ErrorSource.description_zh: 任务错误来源，仅当 Status 为 3 时返回。SLS 表示日志服务错误，SYSTEM 表示系统处理错误

OpType.description_en: The operation type of the task. Valid values: CREATE: creates a delivery destination. UPDATE: updates a delivery destination. DELETE: deletes a delivery destination
OpType.description_zh: 任务操作类型。CREATE 表示创建投递目的地，UPDATE 表示更新投递目的地，DELETE 表示删除投递目的地

Status.description_en: The execution status of the task. Valid values: 0: pending. 1: running. 2: successful. 3: failed
Status.description_zh: 任务执行状态。0 表示待执行，1 表示执行中，2 表示成功，3 表示失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the log delivery task

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This parameter describes the cause of the error when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因
Message.example: The specified log delivery task was not found.

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true: successful. false: failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
